Method of Attack: Privilege escalation via Win32k component (win32k.sys) to execute arbitrary code in kernel mode.
Attack Vector: Malware installer exploiting Win32k component to gain kernel privileges.

Method of Attack: Privilege escalation via Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) service.
Attack Vector: Specially crafted application exploiting ALPC to execute arbitrary code.

Method of Attack: Security feature bypass in BitLocker allowing access to encrypted data.
Impacted Systems: Windows systems using BitLocker Device Encryption.
Attack Vector: Physical access to a powered-off system to bypass BitLocker encryption.

Method of Attack: Memory corruption in Chakra scripting engine allowing remote code execution.
Attack Vector: Tricking victims into opening a specially crafted website on Microsoft Edge.

Method of Attack: Remote code execution via Windows Deployment Services TFTP server.
Impacted Systems: Windows systems using Windows Deployment Services TFTP server.
Attack Vector: Exploitation of memory handling in TFTP server.

Method of Attack: Remote code execution via Microsoft Graphics Components.
Impacted Systems: Windows systems using Microsoft Graphics Components.
Attack Vector: Exploitation of memory handling in graphics components.

Method of Attack: Remote code execution via Windows VBScript engine.
Attack Vector: Exploitation of memory handling in VBScript engine.

Method of Attack: Remote code execution via Microsoft Dynamics 365 (on-premises) version 8.
Attack Vector: Sending a specially crafted request to a vulnerable Dynamics server.
